name: Top-vs-Global Positioning Divergence
research_question: Do extreme divergences between Binance top-trader position-weighted long/short positioning and broad-account long/short positioning predict subsequent perp returns in the direction of top-trader positioning after realistic costs?

anti_duplication.LL-0016-C: Funding-extreme plus OI-expansion crowd-unwind is CLOSED NO_EDGE and is not reopened.

anti_duplication.novel_information: Cross-sectional participant-class positioning divergence: position-weighted TOP traders versus GLOBAL account-count positioning.

source.operational_raw_reuse: LL-0016-B Run02 immutable RAW bytes only; no LL-0016 result transfer
source.normalization_rule: strict named-day half-open containment; no imputation

primary_feature.interpretation: position-weighted TOP-trader long/short skew relative to broad-account long/short skew
primary_feature.causal_zscore: 30 calendar days, current row excluded, >=99% 5m coverage
primary_feature.direction: FOLLOW sign(D): positive extreme=LONG, negative extreme=SHORT

decision_rule: ALL primary gates must pass. Diagnostics cannot rescue. A survivor only permits a separately frozen 2024H1 confirmation; it is not an edge or promotion.
